parameters.content:
## Exercise 2: Real ticket creation
Select your Google Sheets credential. Select **Document From list** and **Sheet From list** using the same Sheet as Day 1.
**LAST: set Data Mode to Auto-Map Input Data to Columns.** Destination changes may reset it.
Headers must be exactly time, sender, category, draft_reply.
**Save AND Publish this helper.** In Exercise 3 select this workflow in the **create_ticket** tool. Saving alone cannot activate the callable tool.

Each successful tool call creates a real Sheet row. Repeated runs can create duplicates. No customer email, Slack post or refund is sent.
